coverage.assertion: Seeded category counts, relation integrity, history and query oracles pass before timing.
Run admitted reduced/full scales with detailed properties, ports, systems and parametric records.
Measure bulk readiness, isolated operations, aged mixed traffic, contention and working sets.
Report failures, latency distributions, achieved/offered load, resource peaks and capacity limits.
State that database-only synthetic results do not qualify geometry or a real hospital inventory.

limitations: The reduced working set cannot establish full-model cache or memory sensitivity.
Four arms are one controlled sequence, not four full-capacity qualifications.
Only one resource changes per arm; declaration ceilings are not a product minimum.
All records are synthetic metadata; geometry, engineering authority and production adoption remain unqualified.
Cluster WAL/checkpoint counters may include private-cluster background maintenance; per-database I/O and raw activity are retained.
Completion and source-body fidelity do not qualify broad interactive tail latency or concurrent offered-load capacity.
decisionImplications: Preserve both original failed two-hour full trials and all new attempts.
Interpret configuration/resource effects only at their executed scale and source.
Further full history, contention, IFC/kernel and authority qualification remains necessary.
